as_told.title: JFK's wish to share UFO knowledge with Russia alarmed officials

plain: President John F. Kennedy is said to have wanted to share what the US knew about UFOs with the Soviet Union in the early 1960s. Jesse Michels raises it as a rumor that Kennedy wanted a joint space program with the Soviets, using UFOs as "a unifying, you know, rallying cry." Harold Malmgren, who served as an adviser to Presidents Kennedy, Johnson, Nixon and Ford, answers on the same episode as someone inside government at the time. He says Kennedy "expressed verbally to a number of the senior people his desire to share our knowledge of UFOs with Russia" and that this "caused alarm." Malmgren speaks of sharing knowledge rather than a joint space program, and ties it to the Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev. The tellers raise it because, if true, it would mean a president was ready to open the UFO secret to America's main rival, and that some of his own officials feared it.
